rv.q: Seeing the new play at Lincoln Center feels almost like a busman’s holiday in these politically oversaturated times.
Overall, “N/A” is an interesting, witty, and engaging new play. Holland Taylor and Ana Villafañe will give their audience a history lesson as they deliver remarkable lead performances.

vr.q: Overall, I found this play to be incredibly fascinating and a perfect companion piece to Suffs.
I thought this play was more interesting as a concept than in practice
